trace_summary.task_objective: A fixed three-hop retrieval pipeline over Wikipedia abstracts. It performs exactly three retrievals and returns the concatenation of everything retrieved. Completing three hops is correct behaviour, not premature or incomplete termination.
trace_summary.final_output_summary: The system completed all three hops and returned 24 documents (with duplicates). The claim asks whether Universal Studios Florida hosts both the Back to the Future Ride and the attraction adjacent to Springfield (Universal Studios Hollywood). The retrieved documents show that Back to the Future: The Ride was replaced by The Simpsons Ride at Universal Studios Florida, and that The Simpsons Ride is adjacent to Springfield at Universal Studios Hollywood. The Simpsons Ride exists at both Universal Studios Florida and Universal Studios Hollywood.
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline executed as specified: it performed three retrievals using generated queries and returned all 24 retrieved documents. The summarizer steps correctly identified that Back to the Future: The Ride no longer exists at Universal Studios Florida (replaced by The Simpsons Ride) and that The Simpsons Ride is the attraction adjacent to Springfield at Universal Studios Hollywood. The query generator steps produced increasingly focused queries to clarify temporal and spatial relationships. While the summaries contained reasoning about claim verification (which is their specified role), the pipeline correctly did not emit a verdict and instead returned the concatenated document list as specified. All seven expected steps ran successfully.
